name: Random person you met on the trail
message: CONGRATULATIONS! Thank you for sharing your journey so I could sit in my warm, comfy home and tear up reading about your awesomeness! You have inspired me to get out and hike more, especially along the AT (I live in Maine) and especially with fun treats I can give to hikers.

name: Noah
message: You're a rockstar. love you so <3

name: Mom
message:
A.M.A.Z.I.N.G!
What a beautiful, wonderful journey. Thank you for sharing so many of your stories with us. I love you!

name: Lynn
message: Congratulations Laura. Thank you for sharing your journey. You are amazing, strong and determined. I knew from the minute you mentioned that you were considering hiking the AT that you would complete it. That is just who you are. We are so proud of you. Please give your wonderful parents hugs from us. Hoping to see you all again soon.
